name: Flame Blade

sustain.label: Flame Blade
sustain.help: A Magic action: a melee spell attack with the blade, 3d6 + your spellcasting modifier Fire damage.

summary: A fiery scimitar in your hand: Magic action melee spell attacks for 3d6 + modifier Fire; it sheds light.
text: A blade of fire shaped like a scimitar forms in your free hand and lasts for the duration. If you let go of it, it vanishes, but you can call it back to your hand as a Bonus Action. As a Magic action you can make a melee spell attack with it; on a hit the target takes Fire damage equal to 3d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The blade sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for a further 10 feet. Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2.
